sharedVisualBrief:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity desktop application screen, landscape about 2048 x 1280. Only the application UI fills the entire image: no device, browser chrome, collage, margins outside the app, annotations, explanation or presentation heading. This is an illustrative NEXG merchant portal design. Extremely readable realistic UI typography and careful alignment, calm information-rich professional interface, restrained serif page heading and clean sans-serif body. Ink #141414 vertical sidebar, warm cream #f6f3ec workspace, white panels, gold #d4a72c used selectively for current navigation and primary actions, dark readable text, fine neutral borders, small consistent line icons, no decorative gradients or oversized decorative cards. No personal photos or brand-logo imagery.
Consistent shell: NEXG wordmark top left. Sidebar items EXACTLY: Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings. Only current screen highlighted. Small Help link at sidebar foot. Shared top header: "Savanna Mobility", location selector "Westlands", "Preview data" badge, Help icon, notification bell, owner avatar "ZM". This fictional merchant separately enabled vehicle rentals AND airport transfers. A chauffeur option alone does not create transfer activity. Locale Kenya, currency KES, dates October 2026 and Africa/Nairobi. Booking calendar owned by NEXG; external fleet catalogue supplies asset descriptions read-only; accounting receives posted transaction exports. Every number is fictional preview data. Use one coherent populated state, applicable enabled controls and sensible entry points to secondary features, never every modal open together. Fit a complete useful screen with readable dense tables, adequate whitespace and intentional hierarchy.
